rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing Professional Development (CPD) from at least two of four categories: professional activities (peer consultation max 18 h, outcome monitoring, service, conventions, Board exam/expert work, Board meetings), academic (courses, teaching, supervision, publications, self-directed learning max 6 h), sponsored CE max 27 h (APA, CPA, ABPsi, CMA, ACCME), ABPP board certification (36 h)
rules.alternatives: ABPP board certification awarded in the renewal cycle counts for all 36 hours (Senior Option ABPP: 18 hours).
rules.audit_note: Certify compliance under penalty of perjury on renewal; keep CPD records 4 years; random audits.
rules.notes: 4 h laws & ethics and 4 h cultural diversity/social justice are part of the 36 h. Same course not claimable twice per period. Reactivation: 36 h in prior 24 months. One-time 6 h suicide risk assessment & intervention (B&P 2915.4) by first renewal after 1/1/2020; also for applicants.
rules.rule_quote: All licensees who are renewing with an active license must adhere to the Continuing Professional Development (CPD) to fulfill the 36–hour renewal requirement.
